results.title: Movie mad
results.brief_description: Inspired by a hollywood gossip mag, our animated amphibian, “Flip the Frog” apes Chaplin, woos a Manequin, and infiltrates a movie studio to various slapstick ends. Laurel & Hardy appear in parody form. Curious for its use of exagerated gestural style for comic effect. NOTE: This is a silent print of a sound cartoon.

results.title: Movie-star commercials & important messages
results.brief_description: Assembled here is an amazing and rare collection of commercials and important tv messages made between the 40s to the mid 80s starring some of Hollywood’s greatest actors and actresses. The varying quality of some of the advertisements is due to the rarity of the original film sources and includes commercials that capture great historical moments, for example: Humphrey Bogart promoting Red Cross during during filming on “Casablanca”. John Wayne represents Crosby Shoes in an ad that used the feet of five hanged men to display the shoes. After 72 takes he declared, “noboby’s perfect”. James Dean appears in a community announcement warning of the dangers of fast driving. He prophetically quips upon exiting about the potential of his own death, ironically two weeks before he was killed in a car crash. John Lennon sells ‘peace’ in an amazing ‘bed-in’ manoeuvre not to be forgotten. This collection includes stars (amongst many others) as: Anne Margaret, Buster Keaton, Laurel & Hardy, Groucho Marx, Ronald Reagan, Betty Grable, Elvis Presley, Jack Benny, Richard Burton, Red Skelton, Bob Hope, Dick Van Dyke, Jane Wyman, Marilyn Monroe, the Three Stooges.

results.title: Movement in time and space
results.creator_credit: Eileen Molony and British Broadcasting Corporation
results.brief_description:
Episode number 6 of Series “Discovery and Experience”.
The outside world consists of experiences rather than objects, to the young child. Socialisation of the school child takes place only after a series of explorations and discoveries about being a person. Music, movement, and drama once considered recreational functions, are now regarded as ways of exploring space, time and personality.

results.brief_description:

Several photographers discuss their techniques and show pictures of their style, including Ernst Haas, famous for his highly original colour photographs.

results.title: Mouth to mouth (AFC)
results.creator_credit: John Duigan, John Sainken, Vega Film Productions and Victorian Film Corporation
results.brief_description: Two teenage girls escape from a youth training centre and head for the city finding work in a food bar. Eventually they end up sharing a derelict warehouse with two unemployed boys they have met, one from an Italian family and the other from the country, and for awhile the openness and warmth of their relationships transcend their depressing economic circumstances. This is a film about survival, interpersonal relationships and the inevitable disintegration of the group. Cast includes Kim Krejus, Sonia Peat, Ian Gilmour, Sergio Frazetto. Cinematography by Tow Cowan; Nigel Buesst as camera assistant.

results.title: Mouse-activated candle lighter
results.creator_credit: Prism Productions and Sterling Educational Films
results.brief_description: The mouse-activated candle lighter illustrates various forms of potential and kinetic energy. It is made from a mousetrap, fishing rod, alarm clock, ice-pack, train motor, rubberband, match and candle. Students are challenged to find the many forms of energy hidden in the mechanism and their movements. Suitable for secondary level.

results.title: Mountains, materials and technology
results.creator_credit: Mike Lockey, Bob Thorpe and London Television Service
results.brief_description: Examines some of the latest developments to help people survive in hostile environments. Discusses the manufacture of new fabrics which have been used to design a new generation of tents, clothing and sleeping bags for surviving high altitude conditions. Also looks at how the use of a global positioning system can be used to help the lives of people stranded at sea or on land.
